sections.theory:
Leg Spin

The skill of turning the ball with the wrist is called leg spin. In leg spin the bowler, turning the hand in such a way, throws the ball from the back part of the hand that the ball, landing on the pitch at the leg, passes from the off side of the right-hand batsman.

Off Spin

In off spin the ball is turned with the fingers in such a way that the ball, landing on the off stump of the right-hand batsman, comes towards the leg stump. In both kinds of bowling the action of projectile motion is involved. The better the parabola (Parabola), the more the possibilities of spin.

Batting

In the skill of batting there are the following components.

Foot work (Foot Work)

Timing (Timing)

Foot Work

The batsman adjusting his body position according to the line and length (Line and Length) of the ball is called footwork.

Timing

The player hitting the ball at that time when he is in such a position that the ball is near his body and he succeeds in hitting the ball with the centre of the bat.
